name: Ivanhoe Electric Inc.
description: Ivanhoe Electric is a U.S.-focused copper developer advancing the Santa Cruz Copper Project in Casa Grande, Arizona, a high-grade underground deposit targeting 99.99% pure copper cathode via heap leach over a 23-year mine life. A Preliminary Feasibility Study completed in June 2025 defined an after-tax NPV of $1.9 billion, and the company has secured a $200 million bank credit facility for project development. Ivanhoe Electric also holds a 50/50 joint venture with Saudi Arabia's Ma'aden to explore the Arabian Shield.
